subject.title: fix: speed up doctor on large SQLite state

question: Should this PR merge on its focused query-shape and corruption-repair tests, or should it first include inspectable after-fix operator evidence from a supported Doctor or update run?
rationale: The branch changes the integrity and repair sequence for persisted state, while the available operator-level attempts did not yield evidence that reviewers can inspect; the PR body alone cannot establish a maintainer proof override.

options.title: Add live Doctor or update proof
options.body: Attach redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact from a supported after-fix run that demonstrates the healthy large-state path and preserves normal completion.

options.title: Accept the test-backed risk
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the focused corruption tests and exact-head checks as sufficient despite the missing inspectable operator run.

recommendation.title: Add live Doctor or update proof
recommendation.body: Attach redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact from a supported after-fix run that demonstrates the healthy large-state path and preserves normal completion.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete owns the proposed implementation and is the best available contact to supply the missing deployment evidence; no named current-main reviewer was established from the supplied context.
